versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Sleepers bank Rest for every round they sit unmoved, and Rest doubles any permanent buff they get, from any card.
One build hoards Rest for a huge fight-time cash-in; the other spends it often so each Wake sets off chain buffs.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wrote down the timing the Wake chain needs: Rest builds after End of Turn effects, Wakes queue one at a time, and Wakes in fights give fight-only stats.
Buffs now say permanently, Echo Nave Choir's reach is spelled out, Pool Olmling's Wake order is set and it also Wakes when you play beside it.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
